author: The Infographics Show
description:
Space telescope James Webb found “universe breakers” that appeared too massive, too bright, and too developed to exist so soon after the Big Bang. Some galaxies seemed fully formed only a few hundred million years after the universe began, forcing astronomers to question whether our timeline of cosmic evolution was fundamentally wrong.

This video explores what the James Webb Space Telescope actually discovered, why several early galaxies challenged the standard Lambda-CDM model, and how closer observations changed the picture. We examine redshift errors, little red dots, hidden supermassive black holes, the Hubble Tension, early dark energy, and the possibility that astronomers were measuring the wrong kind of light.
We also investigate more radical theories, including Rajendra Gupta’s claim that the universe could be 26.7 billion years old and Roger Penrose’s Conformal Cyclic Cosmology, which suggests the Big Bang may have been the ending of a previous universe rather than the true
title: James Webb Found Universe Breakers. Is The Big Bang WRONG?
